**Investment Thesis**
Alphabet is a best-in-class quality compounder (30%+ ROIC, record 60% gross margins, cash-backed earnings) mid-way through an AI-driven re-acceleration — revenue growth at ~24% YoY, Cloud at +63%, estimate revisions +18% — trading at ~22x FY27E EPS versus a ~19% EPS CAGR (PEG ≈ 1.2). The offsetting forces are real but priced: the heaviest legal overlay in large-cap tech (antitrust remedies, EU DMA, a new securities class action) and a capex program ($195–205B guided for 2026) that compresses reported FCF toward zero this year. We own it at fair value, not cheap — hence Medium conviction, disciplined scaling, and a hard requirement that AI capex converts before full size.

- **Macro & Sector:** Constructive-neutral. Nominal GDP ~5–6% feeds ad budgets and enterprise IT; no recession signal (curve de-inverted +34bp). The tension is the 10Y at ~5.0–5.3% — a direct cap on long-duration multiples. GOOG's net-cash balance sheet insulates it from the funds rate; the bear macro scenario (10Y → 5.75–6.0%) is a ~25–30% drawdown risk to the stock despite flawless fundamentals. Sector itself is attractive: digital ads + cloud/AI grow double-digit; GOOG holds #2 internet operating margins (32.1%).

- **Geopolitical & Legal:** HIGH risk — the dominant co-factor. Live adverse rulings on Search (remedy appeal pending at DC Circuit, DOJ seeks harsher terms) and ad tech (partial liability; remedies outcome resolving now, ~Oct 2026). First-ever EU DMA fine (€890M) plus reported €2.95B ad-tech fine; UK CMA SMS and India CCI parallel proceedings; new securities class action on Gemini 3.5 Pro launch claims (lead-plaintiff deadline Nov 30, 2026). Not existential — cash absorbs fines — but remedies that reshape Search distribution or ad-tech ownership directly hit the ~75%-of-revenue ad engine. Model: discount US/EU ad growth ~100–150bp, reserve $10–25B for legal.

- **Equity Fundamentals — Value (HOLD stance):** Wide and widening moat, 9/10 financial quality, fortress balance sheet ($126.8B cash vs $59.3B debt), ROIC 27–32% four years running, normalized FCF $115–135B (reported $73B is capex-depressed, not deterioration). Intrinsic value triangulates to ~$330–360 (midpoint ~$345) — the market is paying essentially fair value with **zero margin of safety**; the value desk's buy zone is $240–275.

- **Equity Fundamentals — Growth (BUY stance):** Seven consecutive quarters of accelerating growth (12% → 24%), record margins, 100% beat rate, +18.3% three-month earnings revisions, FY30 consensus EPS $25.05 (19%+ CAGR). $1.8–2.0T combined SAM with single-digit penetration of the AI wave. Full-stack AI advantage (Gemini + TPU + distribution) unmatched by peers. Cheaper than its own growth: ~22x FY27E, PEG ≈ 1.2 — but the entire call rests on capex converting to owner earnings.

Top-decile quality (ROE 31.8%, negative accruals −0.055), +18.3% revision impulse — but momentum is **negative** (−1.73%, 19th/25 peers), alpha negative (−6%), beta 1.31. The real channels are market risk (31% vol, beta ~1.1–1.3, −29% 3Y max drawdown) and FCF-yield compression (1.8% reported; ~3% normalized). Emissions +48% vs 2019 with net-zero pledge quietly diluted; Gemini autonomous-breach disclosure (Sept 2026); governance 6/10 on founder control. Fines (~€3B GDPR cumulative) are rounding errors vs cash flow. Not thesis-killing, but direction of travel is negative.
